description: This file defines the SearchFragment class, which manages a search interface in an Android music player app. It sets up a RecyclerView to display songs and filters the list based on user input in real time.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that provides a searchable list of songs with real-time filtering.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's view, sets up RecyclerView, attaches data, and adds a listener for search input changes.

methods.name: filterSongs
methods.description: Filters the list of all songs based on the search text and updates the displayed list.
